title: Subagent via Claude Code (subagent_claude_code)
category: 多代理 / 子代理（Claude Code 提供方）
summary: 用 Claude Code provider 委托一个子代理。参数与 subagent 相同（description + prompt，one-shot 前台执行，深度由 provider 管理）。注意：production dsh 默认不安装该 provider，需先安装对应 Bundle 并解除 tool-subagent-claude-code 行的 disabled。
when_to_use: 用户明确要求用 Claude Code 作为子代理后端
已安装 claude-code Bundle 并启用该行
not_for: 默认 spawn 委托（用 subagent）
未安装 claude-code Bundle 时（会 UNKNOWN_TOOL / 挂载失败）

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

run_in_background.description: Whether to run in the background and return a durable subagent id immediately. Defaults to true. Set false to wait for the result when your next action depends on it.

commands.name: subagent_claude_code
commands.usage: subagent_claude_code({ description: "<3-5词>", prompt: "<完整独立任务描述>" })
commands.desc: 必需 description: string、prompt: string；输出 { kind: 'background'|'result', ... }（one-shot，默认前台等待结果）
